_comment: MCP servers deployed to ~/.claude.json by stage 75.
NOT settings.json: Claude Code does not read `mcpServers` from settings.json.
It reads ~/.claude.json (user/local scope) and .mcp.json (project scope). An
mcpServers block in settings.json is silently ignored — it loads without error
and the servers simply never appear in `claude mcp list`. Five entries sat there
~/.claude.json cannot be symlinked into the repo the way settings.json is: it
also holds chat history, per-project state and ~57KB of runtime noise. So the
declarations live here and stage 75 merges them in, leaving every key it does
Credentials are ${ENV_VAR} references only, expanded by Claude Code from the
shell that launched it. Real values go in ~/.config/linux-cfg/secrets.env,
which is outside the repo and sourced by ~/.zshrc. Never paste a literal here.
_comment_zotero: `serve` is NOT a subcommand. zotero-mcp 0.3.1 accepts only
--transport {stdio,sse}; anything else makes argparse exit 2 before the
server starts, which Claude Code reports as CONNECTION_CLOSED rather than
as the usage error it is.
The env list is exactly what the package reads (ZOTERO_API_KEY,
UNSAFE_OPERATIONS were carried over from an older, different server and are
read by nothing here — they only produced a standing `Missing environment
